description: Source code for the database visualizer web interface, including layout, styles, and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying database data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database entries to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display data in tabular form.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell to show full content.
